synRestPost

synRestPost.Rd

Sends an HTTP POST request to the Synapse server.

Usage

synRestPost(uri, body=NULL, endpoint=NULL, headers=NULL, retry_policy=list(), requests_session_async_synapse=NULL, kwargs=NULL)

Arguments

uri

(str) URI on which the request is performed

body

(Any) The payload to be delivered, as a JSON-encoded string (e.g. via rjson::toJSON()). This is passed straight through to the underlying HTTP client's content argument, which only accepts a string or raw bytes – passing a named list/dict directly will fail with TypeError: Unexpected type for 'content'.

endpoint

(str) Server endpoint, defaults to the client's configured repository endpoint (see synSetEndpoints()).

headers

(Headers) Named list of headers to use.

retry_policy

(dict[str, Any]) A retry policy (named list) whose keys should match the parameters of with_retry_time_based_async, the underlying Python client's retry mechanism.

requests_session_async_synapse

(AsyncClient) The async client to use when making this specific call.

kwargs

optional named parameter: Any other arguments taken by a request method

Value

JSON encoding of response

Note

This wraps synapseclient's rest_post_async(), which is a Python async coroutine method. Calling synRestPost() does not run that coroutine – it returns an unresolved Python coroutine object, since reticulate does not automatically await coroutines. To get the actual response, resolve the returned coroutine yourself with Python's asyncio.run() via reticulate, as shown in the example below.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
## Using this function
    # For ordinary entity creation, prefer the higher-level constructors
    # and synStore() instead -- e.g. Folder(...) |> synStore(). Reach for
    # synRestPost() only for REST endpoints that don't have a higher-level
    # model wrapper.
    library(synapser)
    synLogin()

    asyncio = reticulate::import("asyncio")

    new_folder_properties = list(
        name = "My New Folder",
        parentId = "syn123456",
        concreteType = "org.sagebionetworks.repo.model.Folder"
    )
    post_coro = synRestPost(uri = "/entity", body = rjson::toJSON(new_folder_properties))
    response = asyncio$run(post_coro)
    response
} # }
